questions.q: True or false? Our right back should leave the striker to chase the far winger.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. The backs keep their players, and the far wide midfielder covers the outside run.
choiceExplanations: If the back leaves, the striker is free in front of goal. The right midfielder takes that run.

questions.q: Put the defending and the regain in order, from first to last.
options: Right midfielder tracks the far winger
questions.explain: Yes. We cover the far run, blue goes inside, we win it, then width comes back.
choiceExplanations: Yes. We cover the far run, blue goes inside, we win it, then width comes back.
